## 🧑‍💻 About Me

Full Stack Developer with **2+ years** of experience building scalable, secure, end-to-end applications. I lean towards the backend: multi-tenant **SaaS** platforms, **real-time** features, and the data layer behind them, built with **NestJS**, **Next.js**, and **Laravel**, from system design through to production.

- 🔭 Currently a Full Stack Developer at **DevsTree IT Services**
- 🏗️ Building scalable systems with **Redis**, **job queues**, and **WebSockets**
- 🎓 B.Tech in Information Technology, **Silver Oak University** (2022 – 2026)
- 🌱 Passionate about **System Design**, **Microservices Architecture**, and **Clean Code**
- ⚡ Fun fact: I love turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions

## 🚀 Featured Projects

### 🛰️ [FieldTrack360](https://fieldtrack360.com)
> SaaS platform for real-time field employee tracking and team management

- Built the full product with **NestJS** (backend) and **Next.js** (frontend) on a modular, maintainable architecture
- Engineered a low-latency real-time chat gateway using **WebSockets (Socket.io)**
- Designed custom filtering algorithms to clean and refine GPS tracking data
- Delivered end to end, from system design to deployment: **live in production**

![NestJS](https://img.shields.io/badge/-NestJS-E0234E?style=flat-square&logo=nestjs&logoColor=white) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Next.js-000000?style=flat-square&logo=nextdotjs&logoColor=white) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/-TypeScript-3178C6?style=flat-square&logo=typescript&logoColor=white) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/-PostgreSQL-4169E1?style=flat-square&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Redis-DC382D?style=flat-square&logo=redis&logoColor=white) ![Socket.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Socket.io-010101?style=flat-square&logo=socketdotio&logoColor=white)

### 🏥 [PraHeal](https://praheal.com)
> Multi-tenant SaaS CRM for healthcare clinics

- Multi-tenant platform serving **20+ independent clinics**, each with an isolated database, custom roles, and workflows
- Modules for appointment scheduling, digital patient records, treatment scheduling, and e-prescriptions
- Automated **WhatsApp & SMS** notification workflows
- Real-time operational analytics dashboards
